settings.ai_global_desc: Assign default models for different tasks
settings.attachment_management_desc: Manage all conversation attachments with batch delete
settings.attachment_clear_orphans_desc: Safely free up local storage space left by deleted sessions
settings.attachment_clear_confirm_desc: This will permanently delete all orphaned attachment folders. This action cannot be undone!
settings.attachment_delete_selected_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete $count selected attachment folders? This action cannot be undone.
settings.recall_dialog_desc: Select a time range to send past memories to AI
settings.recall_injected: Sent $months months of memories to AI
settings.provider_sort_hint: Press and drag the handle on the right to reorder
settings.summary_generation_mode_desc: Write a custom generation-assistant prompt, or reuse a partner’s persona. Both modes use the global summary model.
settings.summary_generation_assistant_required: Select a partner, or switch back to custom prompt mode
settings.summary_generation_assistant_missing: Partner mode unavailable; fell back to prompt mode
settings.summary_inject_shared_memory_desc: When on, shared memory from the months before this period is inserted between the template and this period’s raw data for continuity — nothing after the period is included.
settings.summary_ai_prompt_desc: Define the AI's role, output format and behavior boundaries when generating summaries.
settings.summary_ai_prompt_hint: Write guidelines for AI when extracting and generating summaries...
settings.summary_prompt_generation_locale: Auto-generated summaries use the template for the language selected in General Settings.
settings.summary_instructions_desc: This setting will be used as the system prompt for auto-generated weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly summaries. You can customize templates in 简体中文, English, 日本語, and 繁體中文.
settings.web_search_mode_desc: Choose how this provider performs web searches
settings.web_search_mode_builtin_desc: Use provider's native search (e.g. Google Grounding)
settings.web_search_mode_tool_desc: Use Tavily / DuckDuckGo external search tools
settings.web_search_engine_duckduckgo_desc: Completely free, HTML crawler search. No API key required.
settings.web_search_engine_tavily_desc: Requires API key. Built for LLM workflows, robust and fast.
settings.web_search_engine_exa_desc: Requires API key. Semantic search engine built for AI agents.
settings.web_search_engine_exa_mcp_desc: Free search via Exa MCP Server. No API key required.
settings.web_search_engine_anysearch_desc: Requires API key. Unified AI search infrastructure; free tier includes 1,000 searches per day.
settings.web_search_engine_local_bing_desc: Search Bing using local browser, no API key required.
settings.web_search_engine_local_google_desc: Search Google using local browser, no API key required.
settings.web_search_engines_tooltip: Choose how the partner searches the public web. Local browser engines need no API key; Tavily requires a key but is optimized for AI workflows.
settings.attachment_delete_group_confirm: Delete all attachments for this session? This cannot be undone.
settings.attachment_delete_file_confirm: Delete this file? This cannot be undone.
settings.attachment_delete_referenced_prompt:
This attachment is referenced by a diary entry. Deleting it may break links in your diary content.
Type "confirm" to proceed:
settings.attachment_delete_mismatch: Confirmation text did not match. Delete cancelled.
settings.attachment_delete_referenced_batch_promp:
Selected attachments include files referenced by diary entries. Deleting them may break links.
Type "confirm" to delete $count selected files:
settings.summary_custom_system_prompt_desc: System prompt for the summary-writing assistant in custom prompt mode. Empty falls back to the built-in default.
settings.summary_custom_system_prompt_hint: e.g. You are a warm memory companion who writes concise, faithful summaries…
settings.summary_data_sources_desc: When generating each type of summary, BaiShou reads the following sources for that period.
settings.summary_data_source_monthly: Monthly: always reads this month’s weeklies; the switch below adds this month’s diaries
settings.summary_data_source_quarterly: Quarterly: monthly summaries in that quarter
settings.summary_data_source_yearly: Yearly: quarterly summaries in that year
settings.summary_generation_templates_desc: User-side templates for weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly summaries. Customize per language below.
